threshold.rationale: At 440 of 549 profiles, incremental extraction saved only 5.7% versus the measured full pass. Scopes at or above 80% use a complete rebuild; smaller scopes retain the measured material saving.

notes: All measurements are read-only and were run in fresh Django shell processes against the same season-4 source rows.
The final-shadow peak includes loading accepted snapshots and roles for comparison, so it is conservative relative to extraction alone.
An affected-mode shadow covering every previously rounding-sensitive profile also completed with zero feature differences.
Publication writes were not executed during benchmark or shadow validation.
